svg.title: Gate Runner · Squad and enemies (#25) · Direction C: Bass Crew
svg.text: Gate Runner · Squad and enemies (#25) · Direction C: Bass Crew
Concept sheet · polished neon low-poly · draft art direction · the squad is cyan (near-white in Overclock), Hush units are pink
The street, a wall coming in
Squad seen from behind (front for reference); enemies seen from the front
Hit flash is off-white for enemies; the Overclock squad is near-white with a cyan glow
A wall at the drop (swarm at 1x, about 400 units)
Each wall is led by drones; bikers hunt the squad from the riser on
Squad: puffer jackets, beanies, respirator masks and a subwoofer backpack
whose speaker cone faces the camera. Bass cannon on the shoulder.
Swarm "Shards": a pink pyramid with one white eye slit. Drone "Damper":
an acoustic-foam dish. Biker "Hauler": a hoverbike behind a big damper
The Hush Enforcer boss is not redesigned here (the request says so).
Ink, steel, plum and fog are Prototype 2 working shades for facets only (draft; strike them if the crew wants the ten-color palette strict).
Idea: The subwoofer backpack is the squad's best read from behind (the camera always sees backs); Hush units are built from sound-dampening gear.
Risk: The backpack hides the gun and much of the Overclock color change; the shard swarm is close to P2's current shapes.
